summary: Provisional access, loaner laptop, and expiry policy for 8-week cross-team secondment
description:
Issue summary: Senior Sales Manager (Elena Voss) will do an 8-week embedded secondment into Product starting 2026-03-16. Request: provisional access to Product Slack channels, read access to two internal repos (product-specs, rollout-playbooks), temporary membership in the 'product-collab' Okta group, VPN access to the private infra tooling, and a loaner MacBook (M2) while her corporate laptop remains with Audit for upgrade.

Impact: Without these privileges she cannot participate in design reviews or triage sessions; Product requests access before next-week sprint planning. HR asked about formal expiry automation and whether we should grant any elevated privileges (e.g., non-prod CI deploy tokens) during the secondment.

Requested duration: 2026-03-16 through 2026-05-11 (8 weeks).

Specific accounts/resources needed:
- Okta: add to 'product-collab' group (read repos, slack channels)
- GitHub: add to 'read' for org repos product-specs and rollout-playbooks only
- Slack: add to #product-design and #product-oncall (read/write)
- VPN: grant scoped vpn profile for internal tooling; no access to prod serving clusters
- Laptop: loaner MacBook (serial MD12345) pre-imaged with standard dev image and MDM enrollment
- SSO and audit: ensure all actions logged and a scheduled deprovision on 2026-05-12

Question: Clarify policy on temporary elevated tokens (CI deploy or short-lived service accounts). Product prefers scoped deploy capability for the secondment to participate in release rehearsal; Security leans conservative and suggests read-only unless approved by Release Manager.
steps_to_provision: 1) Approve request in HR ticketing (done). 2) Hardware: assign available loaner and create asset checkout in inventory. 3) Okta: add to product-collab and create expiration (2026-05-12). 4) GitHub: add team membership with read-only role for listed repos only. 5) VPN: create scoped profile. 6) Slack: invite to channels. 7) Verify logging/audit hooks and notify Release Manager if deploy token requested. 8) Schedule automated deprovision job one day after end date.
comments: 2026-03-12 09:12 — Aisha Patel: Filed per HR secondment request email; target start 2026-03-16. Marking as time-sensitive for sprint planning.
2026-03-12 10:05 — Diego Moreno: Can provision everything except hardware; I need asset ID and confirmation that loaner MDM image is OK. Will block deploy-token until Release Manager approves.

2026-03-12 11:30 — Priya Shah (Security): Recommend no CI deploy tokens. If Product insists, require a scoped short-lived service account with JUST the rehearsal job and 48h TTL, monitored by audit alerts.

2026-03-13 08:55 — Elena Voss (requestor): Confirm loaner serial MD12345 is fine. Product requests a scoped deploy token for rehearsal on 2026-03-23; Release Manager @michael.liu to approve. We can accept restrictive TTL if needed.
2026-03-14 14:20 — Michael Liu (Release Manager): Approves a scoped rehearsal token for 48h only, to be issued on 2026-03-22 and revoked 2026-03-24. Security to generate and audit.
2026-03-14 15:00 — Diego Moreno: Hardware assigned and imaged. Okta group change pending; scheduling deprovision automation.
investigation_notes: Checked inventory: loaner MacBook MD12345 available in office-lab-2. Device previously used by contractor; wiped and queued for reimage.
Okta group product-collab currently contains 42 members; will add Elena with expiry attribute and create an access review task for 2026-05-05.
GitHub org policy: org-admin approval required to add external elevated roles; read-only additions can be done by team-admins. Will add repo-level read role now.
VPN: we have a templated scoped profile 'vpn-internal-readonly' that excludes prod-serving clusters; suitable for this request.
Deploy token: Security confirmed they will create a short-lived service account with a 48h TTL and alerting; coordinates with Release Manager required.
Audit log: ensured logging destination includes the security SIEM and retention for 90 days per policy for temporary access events.
resolution:
Partial provisioning complete as of 2026-03-14: loaner MacBook MD12345 assigned and imaged; Okta group membership added with auto-expiry 2026-05-12; GitHub read-only access granted to product-specs and rollout-playbooks; Slack invites sent for #product-design and #product-oncall; VPN scoped profile provisioned.

Pending: short-lived deploy token to be created by Security and issued on 2026-03-22 for a 48h window; automated deprovision job scheduled for 2026-05-12 to remove Okta group membership, revoke VPN profile, and reclaim loaner asset.

Follow-up actions: 1) Security to post token issuance record and confirmation (assigned to Priya). 2) Ops to confirm asset return and mark inventory cleared (assigned to Diego). 3) Doc update: add a short-run secondment checklist to Confluence (owner: HR Ops).
